name: Generate Instagram carousels and TikTok slideshows with GPT-Image-1 and PostFast after Telegram approval

parameters.content:
## Generate Instagram carousels and TikTok slideshows with GPT-Image-1 and PostFast after Telegram approval

### How it works

Runs Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings. OpenAI writes a carousel (caption plus slide headlines and text), gpt-image-1 renders every slide as a portrait image, and the finished slides land in your Telegram with Approve and Decline buttons. Nothing is posted until you approve. On approval each selected account gets its own uploaded copy of every slide and one scheduled post via [PostFast](https://postfa.st): a real carousel on Instagram, a photo slideshow on TikTok.

### Setup steps

- Install the verified PostFast community node (n8n Cloud: enable Verified Community Nodes in the Admin Panel; self-hosted: install n8n-nodes-postfast).
- Connect your [PostFast](https://postfa.st) credentials (API key from Settings > API) on the three PostFast nodes.
- Connect your OpenAI credentials on both OpenAI nodes.
- Create a Telegram bot with @BotFather, paste its token into a Telegram credential on both Telegram nodes, then open a chat with your bot and press Start (bots cannot message you first).
- Get your chat ID: send any message in Telegram, forward it to @myidbot (IDBot), and it replies with your numeric ID. Put that number in the configuration node. Alternative: message your bot, then open api.telegram.org/botYOUR_TOKEN/getUpdates and read chat.id.
- Fill in the configuration node: brand, voice, topics, slide count, image style, platforms.
- Run once manually to test safely: nothing is ever posted until you tap Approve in Telegram, so tapping Decline is a free end-to-end test. When you do approve, check the scheduled posts in your PostFast dashboard before activating.

### Customization

Change the slide count (2 to 8), image style, topics or posting days. In the PostFast scheduler node's Controls you can enable TikTok auto music and the AI-generated content label. Prefer reviewing in a dashboard instead of Telegram? Set approvalStatus to PENDING_APPROVAL and approve posts inside PostFast.

## 1. Start and configure

Triggers three mornings a week. The configuration node is the only node you have to edit: brand, voice, topics, slide count, image style, platform filter and your Telegram chat ID all live here.

## 2. Accounts and carousel writing

Fetches your connected PostFast accounts and keeps the platforms you chose. OpenAI then writes the caption and every slide as strict JSON. Want a different tone or language? Edit the prompt in the OpenAI node.

## 3. Render the slides

Each slide becomes a 1024x1536 portrait gpt-image-1 image with the headline rendered on it, then every slide is sent to your Telegram as a preview. The look and feel comes from imageStyle in the configuration.

## 4. Approve before it posts

One Telegram message with Approve and Decline buttons, sent by your own bot. The workflow stays paused until you tap. Decline discards the run: nothing is uploaded, nothing is scheduled.

## 5. Upload and schedule per account

On approval every account gets its own upload URLs and its own copy of each slide, then one scheduled post per account with slides in order. Instagram publishes a carousel, TikTok a photo slideshow.

values.content:
=You are a social media designer and copywriter for {{ $('Configure carousel brand and topics').first().json.brandName }}. Voice: {{ $('Configure carousel brand and topics').first().json.brandVoice }}.

Create ONE carousel post about one of these topics: {{ $('Configure carousel brand and topics').first().json.topics }}.

Rules: exactly {{ $('Configure carousel brand and topics').first().json.slideCount }} slides. Slide 1 heading must be a scroll-stopping hook. The last slide must be a clear call to action. Slides must flow as one story.

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact shape: {"caption": "engaging 60-150 word caption with 2-3 hashtags", "slides": [{"heading": "3-6 word slide headline", "body": "one short supporting sentence, max 15 words", "visual": "short scene or background description for the image"}]}
